family: cash flow: capex_resolved (feeds FCF, FCF yield, capex % revenue, FCF per share, buybacks and dividends % FCF)
verifier: VERIFY-DA-CAPEX-V10-2026-11-01.md (origin/verify/da-capex-v10-2026-11-01 02c61c6): capex YES, 15 of 15 right; production wrong or only rounded in every drawn cell

release1.excluded_ambiguous_period_match: capex_release1_excluded_ambiguous.json (8 cells match two production periods; not written)
release1.rollback: capex_release1_rollback.sql (generated, run in one transaction by the Release Manager only)
release1.keep_list: capex_release_keep_list.json (6 cells where production equals the filer's own total; untouched)

removals.label: supplemental_total
removals.rule: a filer-printed capex total below the investing section differs from the release value (filer's total is the anchor)

release2.status: production blank: not in the Verifier's sampled population; needs its own fill stratum before shipping

not_in_any_release: held cells (perimeter_line_unresolved, other_capex_lines_outside_ruling, no_continuing_capex_line): production stays as is until the founder's capex answer and a real-estate ruling

flag.convention: SCROONER_RULES_ENABLED (comma list) with SCROONER_RULES_DRYRUN; default OFF
flag.note: the write goes through the existing flag / cell_store contract; this package supplies cells, evidence and before-image, not a new write path

post_write: certify rerun on release1_touched_ciks.txt; FCF and dependent metrics recompute for the touched companies; any new finding blocks
evidence_per_cell: accession, face members (tag, label, nature, value) from the FSN pre/num rows of that filing; same accession by construction

release2_fills.stale_refusal: release2_fills_stale_check.sql must return zero rows immediately before the write
release2_fills.rollback: release2_fills_rollback.sql (delete the inserted rows; generated, never executed)
